name: Torch Card
description: A plain card where a soft light follows the pointer and reveals a pattern that is otherwise invisible.

props.name: radius
props.description: Radius of the light, in pixels.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the light, the border glow and the pattern. Any CSS colour, including a token variable.

props.name: pattern
props.description: The pattern revealed inside the light.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. It is rounded-2xl, bordered and padded by default.
